answer: Key the bond to a hardware root, reduce the release by each unverified claim, and require attack cost above honest work at every fleet size. A terrace of 400 identities sharing one root holds one bond, so its effective stake per account is 1/400 of honest. Cost: 400 accounts, 1 root, 1 bond, and an ocean of unverified claims that each cut the payout. The jade badge on a verified root does not transfer to a clone.
